perspective:
Jose Castillo has access to the following:

- He works with Patricia at a community bank, where he sometimes helps with maintenance and repairs.
- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual during shifts, especially since she was normally vibrant.
- He asked if she was okay, and she said it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated it.
- He overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He told her he’d been reading about financial planning strategies and offered to discuss them.
- Patricia said that could be helpful and that she’d been overwhelmed with her bills lately.
- He offered to look over budgeting tips together, and Patricia said she’d take him up on it soon.
- He worried afterward that he might have overstepped by bringing up finances.
- He checked in with Patricia and clarified he wasn’t trying to pry, just wanted to help.
- Patricia said she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for his offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend.
- Patricia said she appreciated that and felt good knowing she had someone to turn to.
- After that, he got the sense Patricia appreciated his concern but preferred to handle things privately.
- He later asked about her weekend; she said she was fine and planned a quiet weekend at home.
- He offered again to be there if she needed anything.
- Patricia thanked him and said she’d keep that in mind.
- He continued checking in with her at work.
- Patricia said she was busy but handling it and thanked him for checking in.
- He offered help with anything, even just grabbing a coffee.
- Patricia said she’d let him know and that it was really great to have his support.
- He responded that they were all there to help each other out.
